status_reviews.researcher_notes: Required status-review verdict: 'unclear'. Two unverified WebSearch-AI-synthesized leads (not independently confirmed against any fetchable page this pass) suggest construction may have started 2022-04 and trial commissioning began 2024-12 -- which, if true, would postdate GEM's own 2024-10-04 last-verified update and imply the row may now be operating rather than construction. Two primary-source candidates exist that could settle this (Yichun Ecology & Environment Bureau's 2021-12-03 EIA approval; jxgajc.com's own completion-environmental-protection notice at show-14749.aspx) but both are currently inaccessible (jxgajc.com port-shut; tonggu.gov.cn soft-redirects old slugs to its homepage post-relaunch). Given a ~60km construction-status line typically commissions in 18-24 months and GEM's data is already ~11 months stale, this reads as at least 'stale', possibly 'change' -- recommend a dedicated follow-up once jxgajc.com or Wayback are reachable, since a completion-acceptance notice would be close to dispositive per the document ladder.
